diagnostics.message: The explicit depends_on from :resource.local_file.public_ssh_key to :resource.tls_private_key.ssh duplicates the dependency already inferred from content = tls_private_key.ssh.public_key_openssh.
The explicit depends_on from :resource.local_file.private_ssh_key to :resource.tls_private_key.ssh duplicates the dependency already inferred from content = tls_private_key.ssh.private_key_pem.

The Auto Scaling group can launch the runner instance as soon as its launch configuration and instance profile exist, but the instance role's docker-machine permissions may not yet be attached. Ensure the group waits for this policy attachment before launching instances.
The runner's instance role needs the cache policy available to its instances; the Auto Scaling group can launch before this attachment is complete. Ensure the attachment precedes instance launch.

When enabled, the runner's user data relies on SSM access from the instance role, but the Auto Scaling group can launch before this policy attachment is complete. Ensure the attachment precedes instance launch.
When enabled, runner instances need the service-linked-role permissions attached to their instance role before they start using AWS services; the Auto Scaling group does not wait for this attachment.
With CloudWatch logging enabled, runner instances need the inline logging policy before startup; the Auto Scaling group can launch before that policy is attached to the instance role.

When CloudWatch logging is enabled, the runner's startup logging configuration uses the environment log group, but the Auto Scaling group can launch instances before that log group exists. Make the group creation precede instance launch.
